header.headline: Every number, with its evidence attached
header.subhead: Methodology, source, date, and status are mandatory. Nothing here is published without them.

metrics.label: Telemetry coverage
metrics.methodology: Share of in-scope telemetry sources ingested and normalised during lab-environment runs of the prototype.
metrics.notes: Lab environment only. Not a production-coverage claim. Status: lab-validated prototype.

metrics.label: Daily verified signals
metrics.methodology: Count of signals promoted to verified status by agent correlation during a 24-hour lab observation window; source dict writes the value as 1.430 (thousands separator).
metrics.notes: Lab environment only. Verification is platform-defined, not a third-party audit.

metrics.label: Posture improvement
metrics.methodology: Difference between baseline and post-remediation posture scores measured in the lab scenario after human-approved changes were applied.
metrics.notes: Lab scenario. Directional prototype evidence; customer outcomes depend on environment and scope.

metrics.label: Mean validation time
metrics.methodology: Arithmetic mean time from signal receipt to verified status across the lab observation window.
metrics.notes: Lab environment only. Not an SLA.

metrics.label: Specialised agents
metrics.methodology: Product dict enumeration of shipped agent roles: recon, surface, identity, config, threat, exposure.
metrics.notes: Roster exists in the prototype; per-agent maturity varies and is tracked internally.

metrics.label: Expanded connector catalogue
metrics.methodology: Declared roadmap item; no measurement attached.
metrics.notes: Roadmap capability. No delivery date published.

investorNarrative.note: Narrative only. No figures beyond the registry above; anything unmeasured is described qualitatively.
investorNarrative.problem: Regulated institutions cannot adopt AI-speed security operations without surrendering data residency. Existing tooling forces a choice between analytical depth and sovereignty; Sibernetick is built to refuse that trade-off.
investorNarrative.wedge: Data-sovereign deployment plus human-approved remediation is the entry point into banks, energy, telecom, and public-sector environments where cloud-only AI security is structurally blocked. Early access with design partners precedes general availability.
investorNarrative.moat: Sovereign architecture, an agent orchestration layer tuned to regulated environments, and a growing corpus of lab-validated evidence tied to a published metrics policy. Deployment inside the customer's perimeter creates deep operational integration over time.
investorNarrative.license: Landing site and public components are dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0 (see /open-source). The product application, agent runtime, and detection logic remain proprietary and are commercialised under agreement.
investorNarrative.community: The open landing repository is the public surface: issues, translations, documentation, and design contributions are reviewed in the open. Star the repo if it helps; watch for releases; open an issue or ship a branch — we review.

disclaimer: Lab-validated describes prototype evidence produced in a lab environment as of 2026-06. It is not a production guarantee, certification, or benchmark against any third-party product.
